db:info.db:title: ConceptExample Class
db:info.db:titleabbrev: Test for C++20 concepts and requires clauses

db:abstract.db:para: A class demonstrating functions with requires clauses.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires detail::is_integral<T>::value T ConceptExample::addIntegrals(T a, T b)
db:section.db:para: Adds two integral values a and b.
This function template uses a requires clause to constrain the template parameter T to integral types only.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires detail::is_floating<T>::value T ConceptExample::multiplyFloats(T a, T b)
db:section.db:para: Multiplies two floating-point values a and b.
Uses a requires clause with floating-point constraint.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires (detail::is_integral<T>::value || detail::is_floating<T>::value) double ConceptExample::toDouble(T value)
db:section.db:para: Converts value to double using compound constraint.
Uses a requires clause with multiple constraints combined using logical operators.
